items.problem: First build of the migrated project failed with 6x 'error CS0579: Duplicate System.Reflection.Assembly*Attribute attribute' because the legacy UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs was copied into an SDK-style project that auto-generates the same attributes.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 39-43 (Build failed with 6 error(s); fixed turn 40 with <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo>); copied BackgroundTask\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs holds [assembly: AssemblyTitle/Company/Configuration/Product/...]. Grep of the skill for AssemblyInfo/GenerateAssemblyInfo/CS0579 = absent.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copies all *.cs including the legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs; SDK-style WinUI csproj GenerateAssemblyInfo default (true) generates the same attributes -> duplicate definitions, multiplied per sub-project.
items.change: Add a copy-exclusion in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 so files matching '\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs$' are not copied from the UWP source into the scaffold. Tier 1 (tooling) was chosen over a Tier 3 prose note alone because the agent cannot ignore a script that simply never creates the conflicting file; the duplicate is structurally prevented rather than relying on the agent to read a tip.
items.expected_effect: Migrated projects no longer contain a legacy AssemblyInfo.cs, so the SDK-generated assembly attributes are the only definitions and CS0579 never occurs.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, the first `dotnet build` of the migrated project produces zero CS0579 errors with no GenerateAssemblyInfo edit by the agent, and no Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs exists under the target.

items.problem: The skill had no documentation of the CS0579/AssemblyInfo failure mode, so an agent that reintroduces the file (or needs the legacy attributes) has no guidance.
items.evidence: Grep of SKILL.md + MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for AssemblyInfo/GenerateAssemblyInfo/CS0579 = no matches.
items.root_cause: Documentation gap accompanying the same root cause.
items.change: Add a short 'AssemblyInfo.cs — drop it or the build fails with CS0579' subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md beside the csproj-merge guidance, explaining the duplicate-attribute cause, that the script now skips the file, and the <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> fallback. Tier 3 here only backstops the Tier 1 script fix (covers the manual-reintroduction case); it does not carry the fix alone.
items.expected_effect: If CS0579 ever appears, the agent finds the root cause and both remedies in one place.
items.falsifiable_check: Grepping MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for 'CS0579' and 'GenerateAssemblyInfo' now returns the new subsection.
